blocks.x: How about South America? Were they as knowledgeable there as they were --
They're not as knowledgeable, but they like it. They're not as knowledgeable.

Yeah. South America's such a mixed-up place. They're so busy with their machine guns and their political problems down there that they don't really have enough time to really get with it. But those that are with it, love it. But they have so much -- so many problems down there that you can't compare it with these other countries that live a little bit more knowledgeable.
